vehicles.name: AU Hawk
vehicles.summary: A smoother arched glasshouse and lower front pane replace the old high, forward side glass. Raised arch cuts now sample the original rounded section at their actual height, removing the old shelves. Nose/tail corners are curved before lamp clipping; the bumper slot and rear lamps are rounded. Side glass clips exactly to substrate triangles; continuous door seams and body-colour moulding replace fragmented marks. LOD0 wheels have a recessed barrel and five spokes; glass is neutral grey. Coarse tiers retain their rear paint-to-glass transition. Original colliders, hinges, anchors and handling are preserved. Exported triangles: 2308 / 900 / 590 against 3000 / 900 / 600 budgets. The deliberate no-wing base-sedan interpretation still differs from the sheet. LOD0 side silhouette IoU regresses from 0.9617 to 0.9559; LOD2 side-glass overlap regresses from 0.5551 to 0.5365. Thick dark window trim and plain distant rim discs remain stylised.

vehicles.name: Cruz Missile
vehicles.summary: Reworked the actual body after owner feedback: longer overhangs with frozen wheel hubs, a broad curved nose with swept-back corners, upright facet-projected lamps, rolled upper flanks and crowned bonnet sections. Side glazing follows the actual greenhouse triangles, hidden damage bays sit inside the sloped doors, rear graphics follow the sculpted boot/bumper, and cheap repeated wheel detail funds the body. Intact exported triangles: 2052 / 891 / 576 against unchanged 2800 / 900 / 600. Front lamp envelope IoU improves from about 0.53 to 0.72; front silhouette improves while side/rear and coarse whole-view scores regress slightly. These measured local gains and inspected shaded comparisons are a review candidate, not an owner likeness acceptance.

vehicles.name: Hawk Dash
vehicles.summary: Third likeness pass: wider lower stance, body widening starts lower, sloping shoulders above the wheels, narrower upper cabin, and a rounded nose in plan. Lamps sit closer to the reference shapes and heights; exhaust outlets are closer together. Cheap wheels retained; triangles 2702 / 879 / 597 within 2800 / 900 / 600. New reference-derived tests check local width, shoulder slope, nose taper, lamps/outlets and camera setup at every LOD. Collision hulls and handling retained.

specTwin.sharedSpec: One spec, two bodies (R123): the Hawk Dash and the Lion President name spec 'aussie-v8' in web/shared/src/roster.json, and their profiles' handling (tuning) is identical, held by tools/vehicles/test/spec-twins.test.mjs. Rear drive, 1700 kg, Cruz-like launch, more power per kilo for a higher top speed; the bodies (hull, wheels, damage parts) are each car's own.

vehicles.name: Lion President
vehicles.summary: A new mid-flank crease and upper shoulder roll replace the broad flat side; raised arch cuts sample the original section at their actual height. Reshaped cabin stations, lower rear belt and independently annotated pane boundaries correct the high, forward glass. Window overlays clip to actual substrate triangles. The fascia bends through four broad close-view planes, with graphics sharing that transform. LOD0 wheels gain a shallow dish, lip and broader spokes. Coarse wing endplates remain explicit thin planes with crossed supports; coarse spokes are symmetric. Rear-glass foot stations follow deck height at their own x/z, including the bowed centre, closing the visible foot gap. Original colliders, hinges, anchors and handling are preserved. Exported triangles: 2296 / 900 / 592 against 2400 / 900 / 600 budgets. Weighted silhouette overlap regresses at every tier. LOD0 top IoU falls from 0.9365 to 0.9244, while side improves from 0.9467 to 0.9524. LOD1 side/rear and LOD2 side also regress. The LOD1 side-glass gate passes narrowly, 0.5066 against 0.5000. Coarse wing planes, tyre proportions and high spoiler retain the stylised reference interpretation.

vehicles.name: Pig Catcher
vehicles.summary: Reworked the engine as a rounded casting and narrow cylinder with curved right header, rider with nearly upright shirt and tapered shoulder/neck, faceted MX dome/brow/chin and wraparound goggles, chamfered guards, real annular rope and corrected tank/shroud/mudguard transitions. Exported triangles: 2607 / 883 / 600 within original 2800 / 900 / 600 budgets. Original physics inputs, anchors, hinges and material stay frozen. LOD0 weighted silhouette .8504 to .8552; LOD1 .8497 to .8360 and LOD2 .8288 to .8026 regress. New current-geometry engine/torso gates reject the actual baseline at every tier. This remains below the ~.95 global likeness gate and is an explicit owner review candidate, not accepted parity.

vehicles.name: Postie Bike
vehicles.summary: Refined the CB50-inspired delivery motorcycle with an octagonal cylinder/cooling fins, curved single right header, rounded tank inset ends and bevelled saddle, continuous tapered arms, shaped hi-vis vest with attached bands, cheek-returning face and arched visor/chin lip. Spoked wheel openings remain real. Exported triangles: 2669 / 894 / 599 within original 2900 / 900 / 600 budgets. Original physics inputs, anchors, hinges and material stay frozen. Weighted silhouette .8563 to .8501 / .8241 to .8210 / .8049 to .7932 regresses; local helmet curvature improves and its new gate rejects the actual baseline at every tier. The primary CB50 image governs one right pipe despite generated contradictions. Review candidate below the ~.95 global target.

vehicles.name: Tradie Ute
vehicles.summary: Reference-led MQ body refinement: convex lower doors, inset shoulder and glass, crowned multi-section roof and rounded rear side glass. The nose substrate now sweeps back through intermediate facets instead of a square cap, and swept lamps share its geometry. Owner-tape tray/canopy envelopes and angular neutral accessories remain unchanged. Actual physics, hinges, pivots, anchors and collision buffers are frozen. Front styling is an estimate from the newer owner-model provenance; the local photos are rear oblique and uncalibrated.
